hard_constraints: Produce optimized.stl as one watertight, winding-consistent, edge-connected positive-volume solid.
Stay inside the stated coordinate envelope and above the minimum bounding spans.
Keep material volume between 22000 and 46000 mm^3.
At the tolerance-safe z=1.99 mm probe, provide one continuous protective-panel section with at least 90% solid coverage and at most 10% projected openings, proving nominal 2.0 mm panel thickness.
At z=0, provide at least 5265 mm^2 of mounting contact and at least 90% contact coverage in each 10 x 10 mm corner mounting zone.
Provide perimeter walls through z=8.0 mm, with at least 90% solid coverage and at most 10% openings along each edge, including at a 1.99 mm inward thickness probe.
Use only the supplied task inputs; do not use evaluator-generated artifacts or evaluator implementation files.
invalid_conditions: Missing, unparsable, empty, or implausibly small STL geometry.
A non-watertight, inverted, disconnected, or non-positive-volume solid.
Coordinate-envelope, bounding-span, volume, panel, contact-zone, wall-thickness, or opening-limit violation.
Native project files used as the only deliverable.
metric: measured solid XY area at z=1.99 mm / material volume; higher is better after all hard constraints pass
objective: Maximize measured continuous protective-panel coverage per material volume for a thin electronics cover.
